title: Command
description: List of valid commands that can be sent to the topic 'HMIControl.<source>'

oneOf.title: HMICommand
oneOf.description: Command with optional TASE.2 extension, will generate a ControlSent event if sent to the topic 'HMIControl.<source>'

id.description: Identifier of the control signal. If not specified, "tase2" must be provided and its "tase2_id" is used to resolve the identifier

with_fast_TS.description: When the control reaches its destination, immediately return the paired state output (publish_on_change SCADA output with the same id) with the commanded value to the sender of the control, instead of waiting for the next Dynawo step. The other modules still receive the TS at the next Dynawo step

real_time_critical.description: Compute the control and its acknowledgement (delay, drop, corruption) at once, from the real-time clock, without going through the event queue. The acknowledgement is returned in the reply (see hmi_control-reply.json), the caller is responsible for waiting until its time_received

operatorBlocked.description: Indicates whether the signal is operator-blocked
